Hi Sana / Jordan —

Thanks for the clear asks. I put together a concise MAP and embedded acceptance criteria below; full artifacts attached (MAP-final-v1.pdf, acceptance-test-cases.xlsx). Summary highlights follow.

Scope & timeline
- Week 0 (kickoff 2027-09-27): environment prep, access, and sample data push (5k triage set)
- Week 1: baseline eval (reproducible run on 5k set) — gather accuracy and latency metrics
- Week 2: integration smoke tests (10 live-sim transactions)
- Week 3: acceptance test run; decision gate
- Week 4-8: iterate, scale, & cutover planning

Success criteria (must all pass to move to post-acceptance):
- Business: Top-1 accuracy >= 92% on the 5k clinical triage set (measured by our reproducible test harness)
- Latency: P95 end-to-end inference latency < 400ms when run from their US-East region under sample load (30 TPS synthetic)
- Reliability: No unhandled errors in the smoke suite; <0.5% rate of 5xx responses over a 1-hour soak at 10 TPS
- Observability: Trace IDs must be present in responses for debugging during run (we can redact payloads)

Exit gates / rollback triggers (immediate pause if any occur):
- Accuracy drop: if accuracy < 88% during acceptance run
- Latency regression: P95 > 700ms for two consecutive runs or sustained P95 > 500ms for 30+ minutes
- Data concerns: any evidence of persistent storage of PHI outside their KMS boundary

Acceptance tests (examples from attached workbook):
- Test A: Batch evaluation of 5k set; compute top-1/top-3 accuracy and confusion breakdown
- Test B: Synthetic latency flood: 30 TPS for 15 minutes, measure P50/P95/P99; fail if P95 > 400ms
- Test C: Integration smoke: send 10 end-to-end messages through their triage API and validate expected routing tags
- Test D: Security checklist: SOC2 attestations, short data flow diagram, and KMS key policy confirmation

Owners & signoff
- Business signoff: Sana Patel (MediQ)
- Technical signoff: Marissa Cole (Redwood) — acceptance test owner
- Security signoff: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) / MediQ security designee

Artifacts attached: MAP-final-v1.pdf (final MAP), acceptance-test-cases.xlsx (detailed test cases), short SOC2 evidence packet (link in drive)

If you confirm the acceptance tests and owners, we’ll finalize the MAP doc and ship the test workbook by EOD Friday.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
